comments.body:
Implementation detail for this story (the description carries the decisions). Audit basis: `check_mcp_models.model_schemas()` on origin/main 083620b0 maps 20 of the 32 models (11 explicit `MODEL_SCHEMAS:25-37` + 9 by `_snake` convention); 12 are unmapped: `AttachCommitsResultOut, BridgeAccessStepOut, FileImpactItemOut, GateRunOut, GroundingBackendOut, PlanReviewHealth{Available,Target,Unavailable}Out, PushStatusOut, VerifyCommandItemOut, VerifyCompletionStatusOut, WriteAckOut`. `BridgeAccessStepOut`, `GroundingBackendOut`, `PlanReviewHealth*Out` are nested shapes already authored inline in `bridge_access_check.steps`, `grounding_info.backends`, `ticket_state.plan_review_health`; `FileImpactItemOut`/`VerifyCommandItemOut` are `common.schema.json#/$defs/file_impact_entry|verify_command_entry`.

Schema amendments (the only schema edits):
1. MCP-added properties absent from the schemas: `push_status` on claim/create/sign results and on transition/reopen; `cross_session_warning` on ticket_state, gate_result, transition_result. Add `common.$defs.push_status` (`state` required; `reason`, `detail`, `remote_ref`, `unpushed` string and `since` number, all optional) and `$ref` it from `claim_result`, `create_result`, `sign_result`, `transition_result`; add optional `cross_session_warning: {"type":"string"}` to `ticket_state`, `gate_result`, `transition_result`.
2. Four new files: `write_ack.schema.json` (`result` required; `push_status` $ref, `description_warning`, `cross_session_warning` optional strings); `attach_commits_result.schema.json` (`ticket_id`, `attached` required); `gate_run.schema.json` (`job_id`, `status` required; `ticket_id`, `gate_type`, `verdict`, `error`, `durable`, `findings` optional; `additionalProperties: true`); `verify_completion_status.schema.json` (`ok`, `verdict`, `reason` required; `verified_at_sha` `["string","null"]`; `signed_at` `["integer","string","null"]`).
3. Nullability the mirror invented (model `X | None`, schema non-null) needs NO amendment; absence is the unset form: `BridgeAccessCheckOut.reason`; `BridgeControlOut.paused_at/reason/who`; `BridgeStatusOut.detail/detail_status/live_lock_fence/lock_holder/lock_lease_secs/lock_oid`; `ClarityResultOut.passed/reason`; `FsckOut.returncode`; `GateResultOut.ac_items/criteria_count/file_impact/keyword_count/line_count/passed`; `NextBatchOut.available_pool/batch_size/epic_title`; `TicketStateOut.close_class/close_reason/completion_expectation/creation_channel/creation_channel_inferred/detected_by/force_close_reason`.
4. Enums the mirror dropped (schema has enum, model `str`): `ClaimResultOut.status`, `ClarityResultOut.verdict`, `GateResultOut.verdict`, `PlanReviewStatusOut.verdict` (its file is owned by the LLM-leftovers epic; load whatever the file says), `SearchResultOut.status/ticket_type`, `TicketStateOut.status/ticket_type/close_class/completion_expectation/creation_channel`, `VerifySignatureResultOut.trust_basis/verdict`. Advertised schemas get stricter; real results already validate (`test_canonical_tool_result_validates`).
5. Required sets the mirror relaxed (schema requires, model optional): `DepsGraphOut.{blockers,children,deps}`, `GroundingInfoOut` (7), `PlanReviewStatusOut.{signed_at,verified_at_sha}`, `SignResultOut.manifest`, `TicketStateOut.tags`, `ValidateReportOut` (5). No model requires anything the schema does not.
6. `additionalProperties`: `BridgeFsckOut`/`GroundingInfoOut` models `True`, schemas `false`; canonical wins.
7. Schema-only properties (`CreateResultOut.title`, `NextBatchOut.tasks`, `WorkflowRunOut` x6) are optional keys a tool never emits; harmless under `docs/api-stability.md:23`.

Wire measurement (temp store, real `build_server().call_tool`): `show_ticket` emits 44 keys / 12 explicit nulls where the library emits 36 keys / 6 nulls; mirror-added nulls are `cross_session_warning, last_reopened_at, source_author, source_created_at, source_env, source_id` plus `attestations: {}`. A lean `ready_tickets` row: 44 wire keys vs 33 library keys (mirror-added `attestations, comments, cross_session_warning, description, inbound_deps, last_reopened_at, plan_review_health, source_*`, the re-added defaults `_mcp_budget.py:118-124` documents). Write acks carry five `push_status` nulls (`reason, detail, remote_ref, unpushed, since`) where `rebar.push_status()` returns `{"state":"ok"}`.

Mechanism verified by prototype over `mcp.shared.memory.create_connected_server_and_client_session` (mcp 1.29.0, pydantic 2.13.4): a tool annotated `-> dict[str, Any]` gets FastMCP's pass-through `RootModel[dict[str, Any]]` output model (`func_metadata._try_create_model_and_schema`); `-> list[dict[str, Any]]` wraps as `{"result": [...]}` (`wrap_output=True`); setting `tool.fn_metadata.output_schema` to a self-contained schema makes `list_tools()` advertise it (`Tool.output_schema` is a `cached_property` over `fn_metadata.output_schema`) and the lowlevel validator accepts absent optionals.

Test rewrites (model access to dict/wire access): `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py` (move `transition_ticket`/`reopen_ticket` from `NO_SCHEMA_EXEMPT` to `CANONICAL`; `EXEMPT_GENERIC` write acks become `CANONICAL: write_ack`; `attach_commits`, `gate_status`, `verify_completion_status` map to their new schemas; keep the partition guards), `test_mcp.py:370-395` (delete the pydantic-absent test), `test_internal_shim_removal_e54e_heldout.py:39-46` (assert `importlib.util.find_spec("rebar._mcp_models") is None`), `test_mcp_js_safe_integers.py:183-215` (walk advertised `outputSchema`s), `test_mcp_list_read_surface.py:307-318` (dict rows), `test_library.py:66-68`, `test_bridge_programmatic_heldout.py:189-215`, `test_reconcile_cli_state_removal_82bb_heldout.py:14,80`, `tests/interfaces/queries/test_validate_compute.py:138`, `test_next_batch_compute.py:410`, `tests/unit/{test_attestation_signing.py:292-301, test_harness_provenance.py:180-187, test_claimed_session_read.py:66-72, test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py:367-376, test_plan_review_health_surfaces.py:11,124-134,202,224-235, test_cross_session_mcp.py:130-204,282-296, test_mcp_writes.py:70-89, test_description_cap_warning.py:272-293, test_caused_by_link_validation.py:274, test_create_duplicate_warning.py:217-218, test_mcp_plan_review_status.py:129,152,176}`.

Baseline maintenance: this story removes the CI step `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:765-773` (a censused `ci_gate` workflow `run:` step) and `scripts`-adjacent `src/rebar/schemas/check_mcp_models.py`. Because `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py:357-364` asserts the committed baseline equals the live tree, run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` in the same change and commit `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` (operator-sanctioned on the epic; precedent commit 81da792). State the sanction in the commit message.

Release-note text for this story (`docs/release-notes.md`, matching the existing `## BREAKING (pre-1.0)` form, and a `CHANGELOG.md` entry):

BREAKING (pre-1.0): MCP results carry only what the library returns; `outputSchema`s are the canonical JSON Schemas. Keys a client may previously have read as explicit `null` and which are now ABSENT when unset: on `show_ticket` / `list_tickets` / `ready_tickets` / `recent_session_logs` rows: `cross_session_warning`, `last_reopened_at`, `source_id`, `source_created_at`, `source_author`, `source_env`, `plan_review_health` (list rows only; `show_ticket` still computes it), and on lean list rows the mirror-restored `description`, `comments`, `deps`, `inbound_deps`, `file_impact`, `file_impact_scope`, `no_file_impact_reason`, `attestations`; on every write ack (`comment_ticket`, `edit_ticket`, `tag_ticket`, `untag_ticket`, `archive_ticket`, `compact_ticket`, `link_tickets`, `unlink_tickets`, `set_file_impact`, `declare_no_file_impact`, `set_verify_commands`, `bridge_projects_set`, `bridge_projects_remove`): `description_warning`, `cross_session_warning`, and `push_status.reason/detail/remote_ref/unpushed/since` (`push_status` is `{"state":"ok"}` when delivered); on `create_ticket` / `create_idea` / `create_identity` / `claim_ticket` / `sign_manifest`: the same five `push_status` sub-keys; on `log_session`: `description_warning`, `duplicate_warning`; on `sign_manifest`: `signature`, `key_id`; on `gate_status` for an unknown job: `ticket_id`, `gate_type`, `findings`; on `verify_signature` for an unsigned ticket: `trust_basis`. Keys the library itself emits as `null` are unchanged: `assignee`, `bridge_project`, `claimed_session`, `claim_harness`, `claim_remote_session`, `signature` on tickets, `fsck.report`, `*_status.signed_at` / `verified_at_sha`, `workflow_run.error`, `create_result.description_warning` / `duplicate_warning`. `transition_ticket` and `reopen_ticket` now advertise `transition_result`. Input change: `set_file_impact.impact[].reason` and `set_verify_commands.commands[].dd_id` / `dd_text` no longer accept an explicit `null`; omit the key. Migration: read optional keys with `.get`.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
`src/rebar/_mcp_models.py` (619 LOC, 32 pydantic models) hand-mirrors `src/rebar/schemas/*.json`; `src/rebar/schemas/check_mcp_models.py` (174 LOC) plus 339 LOC of drift tests police the copy. Bug lowly-lawrencium-ovenbird (3a02-66ea-9229-470c, 2026-09-02) found 41 canonical properties drifted out of the mirror despite the oracle, and that model defaults put schema-violating nulls on the wire. A fresh audit on origin/main 083620b0 lists 12 unmapped models, 20 invented nullabilities, 11 dropped enums, and 5 relaxed required sets (first comment). The MCP SDK validates every structured result against the advertised `outputSchema` at call time (`mcp/server/lowlevel/server.py`, `jsonschema.validate` in the `call_tool` handler), so the mirror is a second contract that can only be wrong. Decision: advertise the canonical JSON Schema files directly, return the library payload unchanged, delete the mirror and its oracle.

## Approach
New `src/rebar/_mcp_schema.py` (about 200 LOC): `OUTPUT_SCHEMAS_BY_TOOL: dict[str, tuple[str, Literal["object","array","list_of"]]]` (`object` = the canonical object schema; `array` = the canonical array schema under `{"result": …}` for `get_file_impact`, `get_verify_commands`, `summary`; `list_of` = `{"result": {"type":"array","items": <object schema>}}` for `list_tickets`, `ready_tickets`, `recent_session_logs`, `search`); `inline_schema(name, kind)` hoists `common.schema.json#/$defs/*` into local `$defs` and drops `$schema`/`$id` (inlining is mandatory: `jsonschema.validate` cannot resolve cross-file refs); `install_canonical_output_schemas(mcp)` rebinds `mcp.tool` exactly like `_mcp_errors.install_error_guard` (`_mcp_errors.py:88-138`) and, after `original_decorator(fn)` registers, sets `mcp._tool_manager.get_tool(name).fn_metadata.output_schema`, asserting `output_model is not None` and `wrap_output == (kind != "object")` so a mis-declared kind fails at startup; `tool_annotation_presets()` moves here verbatim from `_mcp_models.py:585-619`. Install it in `mcp_server.py` after `install_js_safe_guard` (`:608-609`). Tool bodies return the library dict or list unchanged with `-> dict[str, Any]` / `-> list[dict[str, Any]]` annotations (FastMCP gives a pass-through `RootModel` for the former and wraps the latter as `{"result": [...]}`; verified by prototype over `mcp.shared.memory.create_connected_server_and_client_session`). `_ack`/`_with_push` (`_mcp_writes.py:85-108`) build dicts and omit `None`-valued keys; `show_ticket` adds `plan_review_health` and `cross_session_warning` only when computed; `set_file_impact`/`set_verify_commands` take `list[FileImpactEntry]` / `list[VerifyCommandEntry]` from `rebar.types`, which removes `ctx.dump`/`_dump` (`mcp_server.py:413-419,598`). `transition_ticket`/`reopen_ticket` gain the `transition_result` schema (the `from`-reserved-word exemption dissolves); the other 11 schema-less tools stay schema-less because the five LLM ops return `_structured_llm_failure` dicts as results (`_mcp_llm.py:28-50`) that a lowlevel validator would turn into generic errors. Null-vs-absent rule: emit exactly what the library returns; a key the library omits is absent, never null (the rule bug 3a02 already applied to 15 properties via `_OmitUnsetOut`, `_mcp_models.py:49-69`). Schema amendments and the four new schema files are itemised in the first comment; regenerate `src/rebar/types.py` (`python -m rebar.schemas.gen_types`); wire the new files into `OUTPUT_SCHEMAS` under keys `attach_commits`, `gate_status`, `verify_completion_status`, `write_ack` (precedent: `enrich`, `review_code_gate`). Also owned here: delete the `"deprecated": False` key from all 37 `MCP_ENV_VARS` entries and the `(deprecated alias)` suffix at `mcp_server.py:684` (`scripts/check_server_manifest.py:18` reads name/description only); delete `uvicorn_graceful_seconds` (`_mcp_serving.py:103,121-123,137-138`) and `DEFAULT_UVICORN_GRACEFUL_SECONDS` (`_mcp_health.py:72-73`) with their asserts (`tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_http_transport.py:536,831-839`). Update the `_mcp_budget._wire_bytes` docstring (`:113-147`; axis 1 no longer exists) and `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py:69` (drop `dump=`) and `:210` (model-field wording), then regenerate `docs/mcp-reference.md`.

## Scope
Delete: `src/rebar/_mcp_models.py`, `src/rebar/schemas/check_mcp_models.py`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_model_schema_drift_happy.py`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_model_schema_drift_heldout.py`, the CI step `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:765-773`, the per-file ignore `pyproject.toml:583`. New: `src/rebar/_mcp_schema.py`, four schema files, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_output_schema_canonical.py`. Edit: `src/rebar/mcp_server.py`, `_mcp_reads.py`, `_mcp_writes.py`, `_mcp_llm.py:24`, `_mcp_budget.py`, `_mcp_serving.py`, `_mcp_health.py`, `schemas/__init__.py`, `schemas/common.schema.json`, six existing schema files, `src/rebar/types.py` (generated), `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py`, `docs/mcp-reference.md` (generated), `docs/output-schemas.md:230-232`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and the test rewrites listed in the first comment. Out of scope: deriving tools from signatures (next story), the 16 MCP-only tools' bodies, CLI or library output.

## Testing
`tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_output_schema_canonical.py`: `test_every_advertised_output_schema_equals_its_canonical_file` (for every tool in `OUTPUT_SCHEMAS_BY_TOOL`, `tool.outputSchema` from `build_server().list_tools()` equals `inline_schema(name, kind)`; for `object` tools also `properties` and `required` equal the canonical file's); `test_output_schemas_are_self_contained` (no `$ref` contains `.json#`); `test_show_ticket_wire_payload_validates_with_absent_optionals` (drive `show_ticket` through `create_connected_server_and_client_session(build_server()._mcp_server)`, pattern `tests/unit/test_runner_running_event_loop.py:150-162`; `not result.isError`; `schemas.validator(TICKET_STATE).validate(result.structuredContent)`; `last_reopened_at`, `source_id`, `cross_session_warning` absent; `assignee` present and null); `test_write_ack_omits_unset_advisories` (`comment_ticket` ack has no `description_warning`/`cross_session_warning` key and `push_status == {"state": "ok"}`); `test_set_file_impact_accepts_typed_entries` (`[{"path":"a.py"}]` accepted; `reason: null` refused). Existing `test_canonical_tool_result_validates` now covers acks. `python -m rebar.schemas.gen_types --check`, `python scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py --check`, `python scripts/check_server_manifest.py`, `make verify`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `rebar._mcp_models` and `rebar.schemas.check_mcp_models` do not exist; `grep -rn "_mcp_models\|check_mcp_models" src tests scripts docs .github pyproject.toml Makefile` returns only fixture corpora under `tests/fixtures/`.
- [ ] Every tool that advertises an `outputSchema` advertises the canonical file's `properties`/`required` verbatim (the diff test).
- [ ] A `show_ticket` payload over the real session validates against `ticket_state.schema.json` with absent optionals, and no tool result carries a key whose value the library did not emit (the wire tests).
- [ ] `list_tools()` count is 64 and exactly 11 tools lack an `outputSchema` (`test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py` partition).
- [ ] `MCP_ENV_VARS` entries have keys `{name, description}` only and `rebar-mcp --help` output is byte-identical to before (`tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py:186` probe).
- [ ] `check_server_manifest.py`, `gen_types --check`, `gen_mcp_reference.py --check`, `make verify` exit 0.
- [ ] Non-codebase: `docs/release-notes.md` lists every field that was null and is now absent (text in the second comment).
